candidate_integration_caveat: Host and domain dependency paths are reviewed published sources, not proof that WP12 candidate includes them. Root intake manifest controls the exact20 shared inputs. Never transfer source coverage or hosted PASS from those refs.
source_audit_notes: All18 producer/verifier pairs are implemented in PR32 host composition; their presence is not availability in an installation and not execution proof.
AnalysisPlan is announced by sf-enquadrar-decisao, but observed host intent verifier only accepts IntentFrame.
UnresolvedCondition is announced as standalone output by sf-contestar-decisao, but observed host critique verifier only accepts CritiqueReport; nested unresolvedConditions are supported.
AlternativeDraft is a published additive output of sf-compor-portfolio and its host verifier; preserve it though older canonical primary output list did not enumerate it.
sf_watch_prepare belongs to sf_portfolio/sf-reavaliar-compromissos positive route and yields operation-level ScheduleProposal, distinct from contribution output ReconsiderationProposal.
Current host review pins are listed in the owner-delta receipt; only the 20 explicit intake blobs were consumed. No broad host composition is claimed.
load_witness_scope: Real SessionV2.skill messages and verified source receipts. Test run IDs are labels, not evidence of durable native provider admission/inference.
